mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) and nephrotoxicity that may impair loperamide clearance and increase CNS side effects; additive risk of QT prolongation exists with both agents.
action: Monitor electrolytes, renal function, and QT interval; consider alternative antidiarrheal agents; use loperamide at lowest effective dose with careful monitoring for neurological effects.
